business_summary: Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited operates as a smart card manufacturer in India, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, Africa, North America, South America and internationally. The company offers solutions for cards, including banking, identity solutions, and loyalty cards; encompass card manufacturing, card personalization, cheque book printing, the supply of related collaterals, tax stamps, holograms, thermal paper rolls, and RFID products; and handles fulfilment activities, such as dispatch services. It also provides smart tagging and IOT solutions that include tax stamp solutions and IoT and traceability; secure logistics, insurance record management, and hologram and coated products; national ID cards, driving license and registration certificate, and intelligent transit management; and payment cards, smart wearables, cheque solutions, NFC/QR, and digital automation solutions. The company was formerly known as MCT Cards and Technology Private Limited and changed its name to Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited in August 2024. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Manipal, India. Manipal Payment and Identity Solutions Limited operates as a subsidiary of Manipal Technologies Limited.
